body: claim_key_package/2 requires a shared (non-deleted) chat or self, refuses either-direction blocks, and caps 8 claims/hour per (claimer, target) in ETS :mls_claim_quota. Controller 404s :not_allowed same body as :not_found; 429 for :too_many. Self-claim /1 still works so existing tests and a device topping up itself are unchanged. iOS establishDirectMessage/establishGroup already have a chat id before they GET /mls/key-packages/:user_id, so the relationship check matches the client.
